I’m sympathetic to the idea of a moratorium at the local and state level. I think the federal level is where we need action, because what’s happened right now is the data centers are able to pit local communities against each other for the least-common-denominator terms.
It’s the end game of the worst excesses of tech generally: to sell us shit we don’t need, but that a few very, very powerful people have decided can make money.
